body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：一條政策被撤回。工程師刪咗原始 PDF，並在 document record 寫 `archived`。點樣證明 retrieval assistant 不會再引用它？
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：原檔已刪，document record 亦標記 archived，下一次 query 自然不會看到它。

這個答案只處理了 source 的其中一個副本。一份 document 進入 retrieval workflow 後，通常會變成許多可以獨立存在的東西：原檔、extracted text、chunk record、embedding vector、vector index entry、keyword index、metadata view、retrieval cache、answer cache、citation trace 和 evaluation fixture。未必每個系統都有全部，但你不能假設刪了一個原檔就等於每個 query path 都沒有它。**Deletion receipt** 是一份可核對的紀錄：哪個 source version 被撤回、哪些 derived records 應失效、哪個 job 處理、何時完成、哪個 query proof 已再跑，以及還有沒有 unknown 或 failed component。

## 由 source event 走到 query proof

先將撤回描述成有 identity 的事件：immutable source ID、version、撤回原因、effective time、owner 和 replacement（如有）。接著列出 derived locations 和清理規則。不是所有資料都必須立刻物理清除：有些 audit record 可能合法保留，但它們必須從 retrieval route 排除，並有清楚 retention policy。相反，若同一條內容留在 active index、cache 或 child chunk，使用者面前仍然可能變成過期答案。

這好像診所撤回一張錯誤表格。把前台的紙拿走不夠；候診室、掃描副本、資料夾索引和自助機快捷鍵也要更新。你需要一張工作單，知道每一處是否已經完成，未完成時前台應該說「暫不可用」還是交給職員，而不是照舊派錯表。

## 清理要有 fail-safe query route

建立 deterministic lifecycle job：讀取 revoke event、找 source ID 相關 chunk／index entry／cache key、標記或刪除、驗證 count，然後產生 receipt。Job 出錯或有 index lag 時，query route 不能默認回到舊結果。它應檢查 source status 和 index generation，遇到未完成撤回就 refuse、顯示 fresh source 未確認，或 handoff。這種暫時少答，比引用已撤回的規則安全得多。

測試必須由 query 回來。固定 fixture 可包含：正常有效 source、已撤回且 cache miss、已撤回但 cache hit、partial deletion、同名 replacement、重複 revoke event，以及一個清理 job timeout。每一行有 expected candidate IDs、citation status、user-facing route 和 receipt state。再測 idempotency：重跑同一撤回事件不應令 count 變負，也不應把 replacement 一併刪掉。把 source deletion、data retention、legal hold 或 privacy policy 的決定交給正確 owner；面試答案只應聲稱你設計了可驗證的 retrieval boundary。

## 可以放入 portfolio 的資料生命週期證據

建立 `retrieval-deletion-receipt-lab`：

- `fixtures/revocations.jsonl`：虛構 source ID、version、effective time、replacement 和 reason。
- `docs/derived-record-map.md`：source、chunk、vector、index、cache、trace 各自的 query effect、retention owner 和 cleanup rule。
- `scripts/revoke-source.mjs`：以 synthetic store 產生 idempotent receipt，不連接真實 index 或 customer data。
- `eval/post-revocation-cases.jsonl`：cache hit、partial job、replacement、unknown state 和 expected handoff。
- `evidence/revocation-run.md`：before／after candidate count、receipt ID、failed component、rerun result 和 stop condition。

一張「delete 成功」screen 不是證據。能被追問的是：哪一份 derived data 還可被 query、撤回未完成時系統說甚麼、以及你怎樣重播這個答案。

## 延伸閱讀

[來源互相矛盾時，要有 owner](/zh-HK/interview-lab/conflicting-sources-need-an-owner)、[RAG 遇到過期或矛盾來源：Citation 以外仲要有 authority 同 handoff](/zh-HK/articles/rag-freshness-conflicts-and-advanced-patterns) 和 [Public dataset 都要有 source receipt](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-public-dataset-needs-a-source-receipt)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。policies、documents、records、indexes、caches、events、artefact 和結果全是虛構 synthetic 本地草稿材料；不歸屬任何公司，亦不代表任何公司現時或過去的面試流程、live system、資料保留政策或 production outcome。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: A policy is withdrawn. An engineer deletes the original PDF and marks the document record `archived`. How would you prove that a retrieval assistant can no longer cite it?
>
> Half-right answer: The original file is deleted and the document record is archived, so the next query will naturally not see it.

This answer handles only one copy of a source. Once a document enters a retrieval workflow, it can become many independently surviving things: the original file, extracted text, chunk records, embedding vectors, vector-index entries, keyword indexes, metadata views, retrieval caches, answer caches, citation traces, and evaluation fixtures. Not every system has all of these, but deleting one original file does not establish that every query path has lost it. A **deletion receipt** is a checkable record of which source version was withdrawn, which derived records should become invalid, which job handled them, when it completed, which query proof was rerun, and whether any component is still unknown or failed.

## Move from a source event to query proof

First express withdrawal as an event with an identity: immutable source ID, version, withdrawal reason, effective time, owner, and replacement if one exists. Then list derived locations and their cleanup rules. Not every record must be physically erased immediately; an audit record may be lawfully retained, but it needs exclusion from the retrieval route and a clear retention policy. Conversely, content left in an active index, cache, or child chunk can still become a stale answer in front of a user.

Think of a clinic withdrawing an incorrect form. Removing the paper at reception is not enough. The waiting room, scanned copy, folder index, and kiosk shortcut need an update too. A work order tells staff which location is finished; while it is unfinished, reception must know whether to say unavailable or hand the case to a person rather than continue giving out the wrong form.

## Cleanup needs a fail-safe query route

Build a deterministic lifecycle job: read a revoke event, find chunk/index/cache records associated with the source ID, mark or remove them, verify counts, and create a receipt. When the job fails or the index lags, a query route must not default back to an old result. It should check source status and index generation; for an unfinished withdrawal, refuse, say that fresh source status is unconfirmed, or hand off. Answering less for a while is safer than citing a withdrawn rule.

Tests must return through the query. Fixed fixtures can include a valid source, a withdrawn source with a cache miss, a withdrawn source with a cache hit, partial deletion, a similarly named replacement, a repeated revoke event, and a cleanup-job timeout. Every row should record expected candidate IDs, citation status, user-facing route, and receipt state. Test idempotency too: rerunning the same withdrawal must not make a count negative or delete a replacement. Source deletion, data retention, legal hold, and privacy-policy decisions belong to their appropriate owners; the interview answer should claim only a verifiable retrieval boundary.

## Data-lifecycle evidence for a portfolio

Build `retrieval-deletion-receipt-lab` with:

- `fixtures/revocations.jsonl` containing fictional source IDs, versions, effective times, replacements, and reasons.
- `docs/derived-record-map.md` mapping source, chunk, vector, index, cache, and trace to query effect, retention owner, and cleanup rule.
- `scripts/revoke-source.mjs` creating idempotent receipts against a synthetic store, without a real index or customer data.
- `eval/post-revocation-cases.jsonl` covering cache hits, partial jobs, replacements, unknown state, and expected handoff.
- `evidence/revocation-run.md` recording before/after candidate count, receipt ID, failed component, rerun result, and stop condition.

A delete-success screen is not proof. What survives follow-up is which derived data can still be queried, what the system says before withdrawal completes, and how you can replay the answer.

## Further reading

[Conflicting sources need an owner](/en/interview-lab/conflicting-sources-need-an-owner), [When RAG sources are stale or conflict: citations need authority and handoff](/en/articles/rag-freshness-conflicts-and-advanced-patterns), and [A public dataset needs a source receipt](/en/interview-lab/a-public-dataset-needs-a-source-receipt).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG standalone practice prompt. Policies, documents, records, indexes, caches, events, artefacts, and results are fictional synthetic local-draft material. No company is attributed, and this is not evidence of any company’s current or past interview process, a live system, a data-retention policy, or a production outcome.
